articles.summary: Whether you love public speaking or hate it, the reality is it’s a learnable skill that every founder can improve at. We recently spoke with Tre Balchowsky, one of the Bay Area’s leading pitch and executive communications coaches, about how founders can get better at public speaking.
articles.title: 6 Public Speaking Tips for Founders Who Hate Public Speaking

articles.summary: Early-stage founders move fast. That focus is their strength, but it can also create blind spots that lead to their company’s downfall. SimpleClosure CEO Dori Yona shares four often-overlooked founder mistakes that could put you out of business.
articles.title: Early-Stage Founder? Here Are Four Overlooked Founder Mistakes That Could Put You Out of Business

articles.summary: Amidst the AI revolution, hardware engineering has remained largely unchanged, relying on disconnected tools, teams, and manual processes. Learn how Tandem is building an AI-native platform for hardware engineering, automating manual processes across the mechanical engineering development cycle.
articles.title: Arjun Jain, Kunal Jain, and Lokesh Kamanboina are Building Tandem to Bring the Efficiency of AI to Hardware Engineering

articles.title: Every is Partnering with Adam Derry's Blue Horizon Legal to Provide Trusted Legal Services to Founders, Startups, and Investors
